questionEn: What characteristic refers to the concept of “physical phenomena”?
choicesEn: Phenomena when the aggregate state of substances changes without the formation of new substances
Phenomena with the formation of new substances
choicesUz: Yangi moddalar hosil bo'lmasdan moddalarning agregat holati o'zgarishi hodisalari
Yangi moddalarning hosil bo'lishi bilan bog'liq hodisalar
explanationEn: Physical phenomena - when the state of aggregation changes.
